title: SpecTrace-CN event envelope v1 (canonical, M1)
description: Canonical envelope for every SpecTrace-CN domain event (architecture v3 6.3). Owner: M1 Huang Xiangjia (G0-M1.5, STCN-25); consumer interface agreed with M2 (ADR-G0-M2-001 item 5). Each event schema composes this envelope with allOf and pins eventType, producer and payload. Semantics: eventId is unique per publication and is the consumer deduplication key (processed_event); schemaVersion is the envelope version, not the payload version, which is carried by the .vN suffix of eventType; organisationId is the tenant that owns the aggregate; correlationId is created at the gateway and propagated unchanged; aggregateId/aggregateVersion identify the aggregate whose state the event reflects, and consumers discard events whose aggregateVersion is not newer than their projection. Delivery is at-least-once and ordering is not assumed.

eventId.description: Unique per publication; written to the outbox in the same transaction as the state change.

eventType.description: Event name plus payload version, e.g. SpecificationPublished.v1.

schemaVersion.description: Envelope version. A breaking envelope change requires a new envelope schema and ADR.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (Z suffix) of the committed state change.
